name: Love Is Curse
source:
You are a student who realizes that your student life was not what you expected, making you a secondary character, until you made the decision to change your destiny after a vacation at your grandfather's house.

While visiting your grandfather, you met a forest spirit, who decided to help you without telling you the consequences.

After the vacation, you returned with the same attitude thinking that the spirit had been just a dream, when suddenly you realized that all this was real and that what would be at stake would not only be a romance but your own life.

The road may be dangerous, but it will certainly be fun. Immerse yourself in a story where you are the protagonist, meet funny and captivating characters, avoid catastrophic situations and most importantly, will you find love in the end?

Find out for yourself in this romantic comedy.

[From [url=https://geumi-studio.itch.io/love-is-curse]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名学生，意识到你的学生生活并不如你所期望的那样，使你成为次要角色，直到你在祖父家度假后做出改变命运的决定。

在拜访你的祖父时，你遇到了一位森林精灵，他决定帮助你，但没有告诉你后果。

假期结束后，你带着同样的态度回来，以为灵魂只是一场梦，突然你意识到这一切都是真实的，危在旦夕的不仅仅是一段浪漫，还有你自己的生活。

这条路可能很危险，但肯定会很有趣。沉浸在一个故事中，你是主角，遇到有趣而迷人的角色，避免灾难性的情况，最重要的是，你最终会找到爱情吗？

在这部浪漫喜剧中亲自寻找答案吧。

[来自[url=https://geumi-studio.itch.io/love-is-curse]itch.io[/url]]
